prompt: I want a login page for a SaaS product — show me 3 style directions to compare
expected: Runs the three kickoff steps first (learn / ledger / capabilities); asks one round of questions and asks for references; three logics × two candidates each = six direction cards (real-world reference screenshotted with ref_board.py, roulette opens the specimen image first); after the six-thumbnail page, picks three to build as full HTML + screenshots (not all in one look family, no look-ledger collisions, at most one trying too hard), design_lint compare shows no collision; presents the three full versions plus the thumbnail alternates and stops
tests: three-direction gate + six candidates → pick three + reference board & specimens + compare and look-ledger self-check

prompt: Make me a 10-page product pitch deck for an AI-tool startup
expected: Three directions × 2 representative pages each (cover + the most different page), deck shell uses assets/deck_index.html multi-file overview wall; presents and stops; after the pick, fixes the showcase grammar on 2 pages before batching; body ≥24px, labels ≥16px; no per-page page numbers; auto-produces PDF when done
tests: three-direction gate + deck module delivery chain + multi-file architecture + font-size floors

prompt: Make a 30-second HTML animation explaining how neural networks work
expected: Uses animations.jsx Stage+Sprite; writes the timeline before the components; entrances easeOut, exits easeIn; tells the story in phases instead of piling up animations; text stays ≥3s
tests: animations workflow + correct easing + rhythm design + duration control

prompt: Build a Habit Tracker App prototype
expected: Asks the user for overview tiles or flow demo (defaults to overview); uses assets/ios_frame.jsx, no hand-written Dynamic Island; Tracker is the high-density type, ≥3 information-density elements per screen (habit completion rate, streak days, trend curves, achievement badges, etc. — not decoration); at least 5-7 screens side by side (home / new habit / detail / stats / settings)
tests: overview/flow shape routing + ios_frame hard binding + information-density typing (high-density type) + multi-screen side-by-side

expected: Overview tiles as the main form; ios_frame.jsx; reading notes lean toward the content-display type, density requirements less extreme than Tracker, but the notes list page still needs ≥3 layers of information (book, quote, tags, progress); at least 4-6 screens (home bookshelf / note detail / highlight annotation / search / notebook management); serif display fonts preferred
tests: overview default + ios_frame + information hierarchy + content-led visual rhythm

expected: Overview tiles; ios_frame.jsx; a running App is the high-density type (map, pace curve, heart-rate zones, per-kilometer splits), ≥3 product-differentiated information pieces per screen; at least 5 screens (today overview / live run data / route map / history / monthly stats); avoids AI slop (no purple gradients, no decorative icon piles — but data-visualization icons are allowed to stay)
tests: overview + ios_frame + high-density data visualization + map/chart mixing + slop boundary conditions

prompt: Turn this reading note into a Xiaohongshu image-text set, around 6 pages
expected: Routes to modules/xiaohongshu.md; three directions = three different paradigms, each with a cover + one inner page side by side; 1242×1660; body ≥42px, labels ≥32px; starts from the assets/style-specimens/xhs/ templates but swaps the example stickers and example palette; xhs_render.py produces the images with no ✗; no external links, QR codes, or superlative claims inside the images
tests: new routing + paradigm pool + template reuse + font-size floors + render script + platform constraints

prompt: Make a Xiaohongshu cover plus a three-page continuous panorama strip for my coffee-shop visit note
expected: The cover is a standalone page; the strip uses .xhs-strip --n:3 with the lead material crossing the seams, each page standing on its own; xhs_render.py slices it into 3 pages with no text across seams; colors derived from the coffee-shop photos or brand, not copying the Mingji yellow
tests: panorama-strip paradigm + seam checks + color derivation instead of copying the example
